data.one_liner: Declarative state management and dependency injection using capsules and side effects
data.what_it_does: Provides a re-imagined architectural approach for applications through capsules, incremental computation, and side effects. It allows managing state and building UI as pure functions of state and side effects.
use_when: You want a declarative state management and dependency injection system similar to Riverpod without family or autoDispose complexity
You want high testability with pure functions and minimal need for complex mocks
avoid_when: You prefer traditional class-based BLoCs or standard Flutter InheritedWidgets
You are not willing to wrap your application in a RearchBootstrapper
strengths: Enables feature composition through side effects
weaknesses: Requires learning a brand new capsule and side effect mental model
Smaller ecosystem and community compared to established alternatives like Provider, Riverpod, or Bloc
data.setup_notes: Wrap your application widget with a RearchBootstrapper widget in your main.dart.
